LEE MAO-CHUNG

Biography

1940 Born in Miaoli, Taiwan.

1972 Received invite to have a solo exhibition in the US

1973 Reside in the US for Modern Ceramics Creation

1997 Return Miaoli to reestablish “Chun-Ching” Ceramics Studio

Education

1964 Graduated from Art & Design Department of the Taiwan Academy of Art.

1965 Study Arts and Craft in Japan

1973~75 New School for Social Research, Art Dept., New York

2003 Public art in Ching-Shuei Rest Area, National Highway.

 

李茂宗LEE MAO-CHUNG (雕塑陶藝)

1940　出生台灣苗栗

1972　奉派赴美陶藝彫塑巡迴個展

1973　旅居美國從事現代陶藝彫塑創作

1997　返鄉苗栗重設「純青窯創作室」

學歷:

1964　畢業國立台灣藝專(今改制台灣藝術大學)

1973～1975　美國新社會學院進修彫塑

1984　美國馬利蘭州哥倫比亞藝術學院榮譽美術碩士

著作:

泥香集-李茂宗陶藝

現代陶藝與設計

李茂宗陶藝

李茂宗陶彫

李茂宗的泥土世界

Notable Accomplishments

入選「義大利世界陶藝展」, 1968, 1970

獲「西德慕尼黑國際陶藝展」金牌獎, 1969

獲英國倫敦「國際陶藝展」優選, 1977

創辦「純青陶苑」，設創作室、陳列室，從事陶藝教學與創作, 1973

成立「李氏陶藝工作室」

1972 Solo touring exhibition of ceramics and sculpture in the United States

2003 Public art installation at Ching-Shuei Rest Area, National Highway, Taiwan
